notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's pvp writer has one verb: CMSG_TOGGLE_PVP with a deliberately empty body (toggle, not set-state), no ack, flag state arriving via the UNIT_FIELD_FLAGS PvP bit. MSUI has no sender for it outside the opcode name and no /pvp surface.
